_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - ɗan wasa ɗaya vs Dealer

📖 BAYANIN WASA:
• Ka fara da {start_chips} tsabar kudi
• Dek ɗaya na kati 52 (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Ka yi wasa da dealer (gidan)
• Kowane zagaye yana biye da tsarin Ultimate Texas Hold'em: ka yi cacin ANTE da BLIND, ka karɓi kati 2, ka yanke shawara kan cacin PLAY zaɓuɓɓuka a matakan cacin, sannan ka nuna kati na al'umma da kwatanta hannun mafi kyau na kati 5 da na dealer. Burinki shine ka ƙara nasararka (lokacin da kana da hannun mafi kyau), yayin da ka rage hasararka (lokacin da kana da hannun mafi muni).
• Wasa ya ƙare lokacin da ka kai 0 tsabar kudi ko ƙasa a fara zagaye (HASARA) ko kammala zagaye 1000 da tsabar kudi (NASARA)

💰 TSARIN CACIN:
• ANTE: Cacin wajibi ${ante} kowane zagaye
• BLIND: Cacin wajibi ${ante} kowane zagaye
• PLAY: Cacin zaɓuɓɓuka a lokacin wasa. A tsawon zagaye, ka na iya zaɓar ɗaya daga cikin wadannan: (${ante4} idan an yi a PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} idan an yi a FLOP, ko ${ante} idan an yi a RIVER. Kuma ka na iya yi watsi a river, ka bar hannun, kuma ka yi cacin ba.)

🎴 RABA KATI:
• Ka karɓi kati 2 (katin hannunka)
• Dealer ya karɓi kati 2 (an boye daga gare ka)
• Kati 5 na al'umma suna rabawa a farkon
• Kati na al'umma suna nuna a hankali a matakan wasa

🏆 SHIGOWAR DEALER:
• Dealer dole ne ya yi akalla PAIR (kati 2 na daraja ɗaya) ya cancanta, yana amfani da kati 2 a hannunsa da kati 5 na al'umma.
• Cancantar dealer yana shafar sakamakon cacin, kamar yadda za a bayyana daga baya.

🎮 MATAKAN WASA & AYYUKA:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Ayyuka: [4x] (${ante4}) ko [check]
  • [4x]: Yi cacin PLAY ${ante4}, nuna kati 3 na farko na al'umma
  • [check]: Babu cacin ƙari, nuna kati 3 na farko na al'umma

📋 FLOP:
  • Idan an yi cacin 4x: [skip] kawai (auto-nuna kati 2 na ƙarshe na al'umma)
  • Idan babu cacin 4x: [2x] (${ante2}) ko [check]
  • [2x]: Yi cacin PLAY ${ante2}, nuna kati 2 na ƙarshe na al'umma
  • [check]: Babu cacin ƙari, nuna kati 2 na ƙarshe na al'umma

📋 RIVER:
  • Idan an yi cacin 4x ko 2x: [skip] kawai (auto-ci gaba zuwa showdown)
  • Idan babu cacin PLAY da ya gabata: [1x] (${ante}) ko [fold]
  • [1x]: Yi cacin PLAY ${ante}, ci gaba zuwa showdown
  • [fold]: Bar hannun, yi asarar cacin ANTE da BLIND

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Dukkan kati suna nuna kuma ana kimantawa
  • Hannun mafi kyau na kati 5 daga kati 7 (2 na hannu + 5 na al'umma)
  • Cacin suna warwarewa bisa ka'idojin biyan kuɗi

💎 BIYAN KUDI:
📊 CACIN ANTE:
  • Dealer bai cancanta ba: PUSH (cacin ya dawo)
  • Dealer ya cancanta & ka yi nasara: 1:1 biyan kuɗi (cacin + nasara)
  • Dealer ya cancanta & ka yi hasara: Cacin ya ɓace
  • Tie: PUSH (cacin ya dawo)

📊 CACIN BLIND:
  • Bai shafi cancantar dealer ba
  • Ka yi nasara: Cacin ya dawo kuma biyan kuɗi ƙari bisa hannun ka
  • Ka yi hasara: Cacin ya ɓace
  • Tie: PUSH (cacin ya dawo)

📊 CACIN BLIND PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Babu biyan kuɗi ƙari

📊 CACIN PLAY:
  • Bai shafi cancantar dealer ba
  • Kwatancen daidai: Hannun mafi kyau vs Dealer's mafi kyau
  • Ka yi nasara: 1:1 biyan kuɗi (cacin + nasara)
  • Ka yi hasara: Cacin ya ɓace
  • Tie: PUSH (cacin ya dawo)

🎯 RANKINGS HANNUN POKER (Mafi kyau zuwa Mafi muni):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 na daraja ɗaya
  2. Straight Flush: Kati 5 mafi kyau na daraja ɗaya
  3. Four of a Kind: Kati 4 na daraja ɗaya
  4. Full House: 3 na daraja ɗaya + 2 na daraja ɗaya
  5. Flush: Kati 5 na daraja ɗaya
  6. Straight: Kati 5 mafi kyau
  7. Three of a Kind: Kati 3 na daraja ɗaya
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs na daraja daban-daban
  9. One Pair: Kati 2 na daraja ɗaya
  10. High Card: Kati mafi girma ya yi nasara

⌨️  UMARNIN AYYUKA:
• [4x] ko [play bet 4x]: Yi cacin PLAY ${{self.ante_amount*4}}
• [2x] ko [play bet 2x]: Yi cacin PLAY ${{self.ante_amount*2}}
• [1x] ko [play bet 1x]: Yi cacin PLAY ${{self.ante_amount*1}}
• [check] ko [c]: Check (babu cacin ƙari)
• [fold] ko [f]: Bar hannun (yi asarar cacin)
• [skip] ko [s]: Skip zuwa matakin gaba (lokacin da babu ayyukan da ake buƙata)

💡 TIPS NA STRATEGY:
• Hannun farawa mafi kyau (pairs, kati mafi girma) sau da yawa suna halatta cacin 4x
• Yi la'akari da cancantar dealer - hannun mafi muni na iya push idan dealer bai cancanta ba
• Cacin BLIND na iya zama mai riba sosai da hannun mafi kyau (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Kiyaye tsabar kudinka! Idan ya kai 0 ko ƙasa a fara zagaye, ka yi hasara.

⚠️  BAYANAI MUHIMMANI:
• Cacin ANTE da BLIND suna wajibi kowane zagaye
• Cacin PLAY suna zaɓuɓɓuka kuma masu tsari
• Yi tabbaci ka shigar da ayyukan daidai, kuma ɗaya kawai a lokaci guda.
